messages:
samir: quick heads-up — noticed telemetry/events still being emitted even when client DisableTelemetry=true in Go SDK. User-agent header is stripped correctly but metrics show up in console. Repro: Make 1 request with DisableTelemetry and check /internal/metrics. Anyone seen this?

kevin: can you paste repro? runtime vs sdk? which transport (http/grpc)?

samir: http transport, Go 0.7.1. snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey, redwood.Config{DisableTelemetry: true})
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```
server logs show UA: Redwood-Go/0.7.1 but metrics event: client.metrics.emit

jess: saw something similar with streaming in JS — when stream reconnects it emits start event even if telemetry disabled. filing repro now.

maria: config flag might disable metrics emission in SDK only, not on server-side if trace headers still present. Are we sending traceparent/trace-id? That could trigger server-side analytics.

samir: looks like both happen — SDK still calls telemetry.Enqueue when stream state changes. searching in repo... https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/289

kevin: quick check — try setting header `x-redwood-disable-telemetry: 1` on request and see if server respects it.

samir: tried that, server still logged events. server-side expects `x-redwood-client-metrics` header set to `false` per older impl. there is mismatch.

maria: ok action — standardize header to `x-redwood-telemetry` with values `on|off` and support W3C `traceparent` for tracing prop. I'll open RFC PR.

jess: note re streaming — code in JS SDK uses new WebSocket for streams and it emits `telemetry.start` on connect. can add guard `if (config.disableTelemetry) return`.

samir: I've pushed quick fix on branch fix/telemetry-toggle — disables enqueue for events. CI green but would like someone to review runtime side too. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/312

ci-bot: build passed — lint OK, tests 112/112 ✅

kevin: I'll add server-side check for header names in runtime so newer header `x-redwood-telemetry: off` will be honored. I'll link runtime PR in thread.

maria: small ask — when you change UA string, please include language/runtime patch like `Redwood-Go/0.7.1 lang=go os=linux` so ops can filter.

samir: noted.

jess: can we also expose env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` for containers? makes it easier for enterprise customers to opt out.

maria: yes pls. include docs update in PR: how to disable telemetry, which headers to set, trace propagation details.

samir: cool. I'll add docs and ping for reviews. thanks all :tada:

kevin: assigning to @maria and @samir to follow up, LMK if you need me to do runtime testing.

samir: thanks, will ping when PR ready for runtime testing.
